activity.notes: Arwa al-Sulayhi exercised ruling authority in Yemen from 1067, initially in conjunction with male co-rulers and later as the dominant/sole sovereign, until her death in 1138. Because the precise transition from co-rule to uncontested sole rule is described differently across sources, ATLAS uses one continuous reviewed ruling Activity rather than inventing a sharp disputed boundary. The polity is styled Sulayhid Yemen rather than treating the dynasty name alone as a territorial polity.

sources.title: Women Who Have Impacted Ismaili History — Institute of Ismaili Studies
sources.citation_text: The Institute of Ismaili Studies identifies Queen Arwa as a major Yemeni ruler who held power until her death in 1138.

sources.title: Arwa al-Sulayhi
sources.citation_text: The compiled chronology records Arwa as a ruler of Yemen from 1067 to 1138, first as co-ruler and later as sole ruler.
